decision.explanation: Thank you for your claim and the jury summons and booking confirmation. The jury summons and booking confirmation support a covered jury-duty cancellation for the 5 April 2025 Vienna trip, and the quoted summons line matches the stated 3 April 2025 date and names you as “Mme Marie Dubois.” The trip cancellation is otherwise eligible, but we cannot confirm the policy period, so we cannot determine whether the 3 April 2025 incident occurred inside coverage or whether your claim was submitted within 30 days of the policy ending. We also cannot determine whether you knew of the jury duty before purchasing the policy on 1 February 2025, because the summons states the jury-duty date but not when you received or knew of it. The documents also do not state that any personal belongings were lost, stolen, or damaged, so that part remains unresolved. Your claim is therefore referred for review to resolve these open points.
